Overview

Cajamarca is a city in CJ with a population of 250,000. A highland city where the Inca Empire fell, known for its thermal baths, dairy products, and colonial architecture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
